english.meaning: causing fear or loss of confidence
english.note: Use this specifically when something undermines confidence or morale and leaves people discouraged.

exampleSentences.english: Being criticized all the time is really unnerving.
exampleSentences.traditional: 成日俾人批評，真係令人洩氣。
